title: Symmetries and Action Principles for Biology
exact_target: Develop symmetry and variational principles that explain biological robustness, modularity, evolvability and variability.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 82 (DARPA-016). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
DARPA DSO, Mathematical Challenges, BAA 07-68 (catalogue attribution: 2007), Challenge 016. Historical source mirror; unavailable in this check.

status_qualification: The problem is a modelling programme and does not assert that all biological systems already possess an action principle. The historical DARPA mirror was unavailable during this check.
